questions.prompt: p̂₁ = 0.150, p̂₂ = 0.106, SE = 0.0212. Compute z₀ (2 decimals).
questions.explain: z₀ = (0.150−0.106)/0.0212 = **2.062**. Against ±2.576 (α = 0.01 two-tailed): fail to reject; against ±1.96 (α = 0.05): reject. The α chosen changes the verdict — say so when asked.

questions.prompt: For the two-variance F-test, which set of rules is correct?
options: Put the LARGER s² in the numerator · df = (n_top − 1, n_bottom − 1) · two-tailed uses the α/2 right-tail column
Smaller s² on top · df = (n₁, n₂) · use α directly
Difference of variances · df = 2 · χ² table
questions.explain: **Larger on top** keeps F ≥ 1 so one right-tail lookup suffices; df = (numerator n−1, denominator n−1); two-tailed → **α/2** column. Drill: F₀ = 3.408 vs F(0.025; 9, 11) = 3.59 → fail to reject (borderline).

questions.prompt: x̄₁ = 42.3, x̄₂ = 37.8, s_p = 4.881, n₁ = 12, n₂ = 10. Compute t₀ = (x̄₁−x̄₂)/(s_p·√(1/n₁+1/n₂)) (2 decimals).
questions.explain: t₀ = 4.5/(4.881×0.4282) = 4.5/2.090 = **2.153**, df = 20. vs t(0.05, 20) = 1.725 right-tailed → reject H₀: Hub A's mean is greater.

questions.prompt: D = before − after, claim: "the change REDUCED the times". Hypotheses?
options: H₀: μ_D = 0 vs H₁: μ_D > 0 (right-tailed — after smaller ⇒ differences positive)
H₀: μ₁ = μ₂ vs H₁: μ₁ ≠ μ₂ (independent)
questions.explain: Reduced ⇒ after < before ⇒ **D = before−after > 0** ⇒ H₁: μ_D > 0. (If you define D = after−before, then H₁: μ_D < 0 — flip consistently and the conclusion is identical.)

questions.prompt: ΣD = 3.9, ΣD² = 2.49, n = 8. Compute s_D = √[(ΣD² − (ΣD)²/n)/(n−1)] (3 decimals).
questions.explain: s_D = √[(2.49 − 15.21/8)/7] = √[(2.49 − 1.901)/7] = √0.0841 = **0.290**. This computational formula (no individual deviations needed) is the fast exam route.

questions.prompt: Degrees of freedom: pooled t (n₁ = 12, n₂ = 10) · paired t (8 pairs) · F (n₁ = 10, n₂ = 12) are:
questions.explain: Pooled t: n₁+n₂−2 = **20**. Paired t: pairs − 1 = **7**. F: (n_numerator−1, n_denominator−1) = **(9, 11)** with the larger variance's sample on top.

questions.prompt: t₀ = 4.754 > t(0.05, 7) = 1.895 in the paired test. The FULL-marks conclusion is:
options: "Reject H₀. At α = 0.05 there is sufficient evidence that the optimization reduced mean page load time."
questions.explain: Decision (**reject/fail to reject H₀**) + significance level + plain-English claim verdict in context. One-word answers leave conclusion marks on the table.
